mapATreeIntroductionSpeech: Hello, I'm The Squirrel. I can provide you items, and lots of things. I know how much you and your friends love items. But I feel alone in this forest.
mapATreeFirstQuestion: I will ask you questions. If you answer correctly, the greatest items will be yours! First one : do you really love checks? (answer in english)
mapATreeSecondQuestion: That's right! Here's something nice for you. Now complete this sequence of letters and you'll get a new reward : S, K, C, E, H, ?
mapATreeThirdQuestion: Checks! Here's a check for you. Next question : how many candies does the candiest person in the world possess?
mapATreeFourthQuestion: Nice! Next reward should be even more interesting...  Here's the riddle : In the multiworld grows a very old tree, on which live the most intelligent animals in this world. It is said that this tree has 60 roots, 360 branches and 2160 leaves. How many marks can you find on its trunk?
mapATreeFifthQuestion: Congratulations! I was talking about my tree, indeed. Hopefully this helps, make good use of it! Next riddle, listen carefully : Under a full moon, I throw a yellow hat into the red sea. What happens to the yellow hat?
mapATreeTicTacToeIntro: Well answered! That wasn't so hard. For the next reward, we'll change the rules a little bit. You'll have to play a game with me! Are you ready?
mapATreeTicTacToeLetsPlay: The game is Tic-Tac-Toe. We play on a 3 by 3 game board. You will use the X sign while I will use the O sign. We place our signs alternately, and the goal is to get three signs in a row. I'll let you go first!
mapATreeTicTacToeNobodyWins: The board is filled entirely and we both failed to get three in a row : nobody wins! Do you want to try again?
mapATreeTicTacToeYouLose: I got three in a row! I won. Do you want to try again?
mapATreeTicTacToeYouWin: Wow, that's an unexpected move. But you got three in a row, I can't argue. You won! Take this key! It opens one of the houses in the village below the forest.
mapATreeNoMoreChallenge: Sadly no, I have no more challenge for you... Playing with you was very fun, thank you for that!
buttonExitQuestKeeping: Exit the quest (keep and send items)
buttonExitQuestNoKeeping: Exit the quest (you won't keep or send any items)
buttonExitQuestNoKeepingBecauseLose: Exit the quest (you won't keep or send any items because you failed)
mapVillageForgeIntroductionSpeech: Hi! I'm a blacksmith. I can sell you various wares I've found on my adventures through the Internet.
mapVillageForgeIntroductionSpeechNoMoreT: Hi! I'm a blacksmith. Sadly, I have nothing more to sell. Come back later, maybe?
mapVillageFifthHouseNoWeaponSpeech: Hello. My cellar is full of rats, I need to get rid of them... if only someone with a weapon could help me...
mapVillageFifthHouseWeaponSpeech: Hey, you! I see you carry a weapon! If you kill the rats pestering my cellar, I'll reward you!
mapVillageFifthHouseEggSpeech: Hey, you! Want to play a game? If you manage to get through my cellar without breaking an egg, I'll reward you!
mapVillageFifthHouseCellarDone: Thank you for getting rid of them! Here's something very precious as a reward : a map of the world. I think you will use it more than I do.
candyBoxRequestStatusBarUnlocked: Request a new feature to the developer (30 candies)
candyBoxRequestStatusBarUnlockedHealthBa: Request for something more exciting (5 candies)
candyBoxRequestStatusBarUnlockedMap: Final request! This one has to be worth the candies. (10 candies)
candyBoxRequestStatusBarUnlockedCfgComme: You now have access to a configuration tab.
You can change the language, if you want to.
candyBoxRequestStatusBarUnlockedHealthBa: Here's 100 health points for you. They're going to be useful.
gridItemPogoStickDescription: This item allows you to jump in quests!
gridItemTimeRingDescription: This item gives you a new ability in quests : you can slow down the time. If things are going too fast for you, use your time ring!
gridItemThirdHouseKeyDescription: This key allows you to enter the third house in the village.
gridItemFeatherDescription: This magic feather allows you to jump higher when you use your pogo stick!
gridItemFeatherDescriptionNoPogoStick: For an unknown reason, you feel that this feather could be useful if you had a pogo stick...
gridItemSpongeDescription: This magical sponge allows you to squeeze yourself just like a sponge, therefore reducing your size.
gridItemFortressKeyDescription: This key allows you to enter the very ancient fortress located above the desert. Who knows what you could find there?
gridItemHeartPendantDescription: This heart pendant will increase your health points as long as you keep it around your neck.
gridItemHeartPlugDescription: This heart plug, made from iron, spider legs, and a special "heart liquor" sealed in the center, will increase your health points by 20 percent!
gridItemBeginnersGrimoireDescription: This grimoire provides you three spells, quite easy to cast. It is really made for beginners. You will be able to use the acid rain spell (a large quantity of acid drops will fall on your enemies), the fireball spell (a giant magic ball made of fire will fly towards your enemies), and the teleport spell (which will teleport you to an unpredictable location).
gridItemAdvancedGrimoireDescription: This advanced grimoire provides you two spells : the erase magic spell and the thorns shield spell. The first one will erase all the magic from a quest at some point, including the spells you casted and your enemy's magic. The second one will create a shield of floating thorns around you which will inflict damage to your enemies upon contact.
gridItemBlackMagicGrimoireDescription: You found this grimoire in a cave, it was very hard to reach, and that was for a reason. It provides you two powerful black magic spells. The first one will create a giant wall made of obsidian bricks in front of you, which can be useful to slow down your enemies. The second one will summon a swarm of demons attacking everyone in the quest, including you. Be careful with this one.
gridItemUnicornHornDescription: This magical horn belonged to a unicorn. Its powerful healing powers will help you a lot. You heard that this unicorn was named Charlie.
gridItemXinopherydonClawDescription: This claw belonged to a xinopherydon, a two-headed ancient animal everyone believed to be extinct. It will double the damage of the weapon you're using.
gridItemPitchforkDescription: This special pitchfork allows you to loosen the soil without turning it over, therefore preserving below-ground soil ecosystems. It will triple the production of your lollipop farm.
gridItemShellPowderDescription: Shell powder is often used by farmers to improve the growth speed of their lollipops. This powder will multiply your lollipop farm production by three!

gridItemRedSharkFinDescription: This magical fin will greatly increase the damage of your fireball spell. Finally this fireball becomes useful.
gridItemGreenSharkFinDescription: This magical fin will bring the power of nature to your lollipop farm! Your production will be multiplied by 5.
gridItemPurpleSharkFinDescription: This magical fin will provide you a new black magic spell. You can only use it once per quest. Be very careful with this one!
gridItemTalkingCandyDescription: This talking candy appeared after you put the four stones at the top of the castle's tower. He might help you to open the candy box...
gridItemAcidRainSpellDescription: This sheet of paper instructs you on how to cast the acid rain spell. This causes a large quantity of acid drops to fall on your enemies and damage them slightly.
gridItemFireballSpellDescription: This page looks like it was made out of cardboard. It will let you cast the fireball spell, which spawns a giant magic ball made of fire and sends it towards your enemies.
gridItemTeleportSpellDescription: This page is a little crumpled, but you can still read it. There are instructions on how to cast the Teleport spell, which will teleport you to an unpredictable location.
gridItemThornsShieldSpellDescription: This stone tablet looks a little old. Saying the words on it will cause a shield of floating thorns to appear around you, which will inflict damage to your enemies upon contact.
gridItemEraseMagicSpellDescription: This stone tablet was broken in half, but you were able to put it back together. Speaking the incantation will erase all the magic from a quest, including the spells you casted and your enemy's magic.
gridItemObsidianWallSpellDescription: This tablet looks like it was forged from the eruption of a volcano. Punching it with your hand will cause a giant wall made of obsidian bricks to form in front of you, which can be useful to slow down your enemies.
gridItemBlackDemonsSpellDescription: This tablet is said to have been forged deep in the supernova of a star. Holding it up while chanting its inscription will summon a swarm of demons attacking everyone in the quest, including you. Be careful with this one.
eqItemWeaponWoodenSwordDescription: A simple sword made of wood
eqItemWeaponIronAxeDescription: A simple iron axe. Well sharpened. More powerful than the wooden sword.
eqItemWeaponPolishedSilverSwordDescripti: A powerful sword, covered by spikes.
eqItemWeaponTrollBludgeonDescription: You took this bludgeon from the troll guarding the bridge. It is slow, but smashes your enemies quite efficiently.
eqItemWeaponTribalSpearDescription: You found this tribal spear on the corpse of a tribe warrior lost in a big hole in the ground. It's a bit hard to handle at first, but once you're used to it, it's a good weapon.
eqItemWeaponSummoningTribalSpearDescript: This magical tribal spear, in addition to being slighty more powerful than the normal tribal spear, will frequently summon tribe warriors which will help you during your quests.
eqItemWeaponMonkeyWizardStaffDescription: This staff belonged to the naked monkey wizard you found in the cave. It will frequently cast spells by itself, targeting your enemies.
eqItemWeaponEnchantedMonkeyWizardStaffDe: This staff is faster than the non-enchanted version, and will also cast a lot more spells.
eqItemWeaponGiantSpoonDescription: This giant spoon was in a giant teapot in the desert fortress. You don't know if anyone ever used it as a spoon, but if so, it must have been someone really big. You probably don't want to meet him.
eqItemWeaponGiantSpoonOfDoomDescription: This giant spoon is even more powerful than the regular giant spoon you could find, for example, in a teapot. It's quite slow, however.
eqItemWeaponScytheDescription: It is said that this scythe belonged to the Death itself. It is extremely fast.
eqItemHatMerchantHatDescription: This hat was sold to you by the candy merchant. The candy merchant loves candies. This hat will multiply by 7 the candies you find in quests!
eqItemHatSorceressHatDescription: This hat was sold to you by the sorceress. It will enhance the effects of your spells and potions.
eqItemHatOctopusKingCrownDescription: When you wear this crown, you feel a lot more confident. It doesn't give any advantage in quests, but self-confidence is important!
eqItemHatOctopusKingCrownWithJaspersName: The Octopus King crown with jaspers
eqItemHatOctopusKingCrownWithJaspersDesc: This enchanted crown is made from gold and red jaspers. In quests, it will frequently cast powerful magic fireballs around you. And also, it's shining!
eqItemHatOctopusKingCrownWithObsidianNam: The Octopus King crown with obsidian
eqItemHatOctopusKingCrownWithObsidianDes: This enchanted crown is made from gold and obsidian. It is beautiful. In quests, it will summon an Octopus King fighting on your side once in a while. What a tentaculous ally!
eqItemGlovesLeatherGlovesDescription: These gloves basically do nothing. But they're soft and comfortable, at least!
eqItemGlovesRedEnchantedGlovesDescriptio: These enchanted gloves emit a soft red light when it's dark around you. In quests, they will randomly cast small fireballs towards your enemies, which can definitely be useful.
eqItemGlovesPinkEnchantedGlovesDescripti: These enchanted gloves leave a pink mark on everything you touch. In quests, they will heal you continuously.
eqItemBootsRocketBootsDescription: These awesome rocket boots allow you to jump in mid-air, so that you're basically flying!
eqItemBootsLeatherBootsDescription: Simple leather boots. Nothing special about them.
eqItemBootsBootsOfIntrospectionDescripti: Take the time to breathe and calm down. If you wear these boots, you will never move as long as you touch the ground.
eqItemBodyArmoursLightweightBodyArmourDe: This body armour will offer you a weak protection. You will be slighty more resistant to your enemies attacks.
eqItemBodyArmoursKnightBodyArmourDescrip: This strong body armour will protect you. You will be more resistant to your enemies attacks.
eqItemBodyArmoursEnchantedKnightBodyArmo: This armour is very special. You will be a LOT more resistant to your enemies attacks, but the damage of the weapon you are using will be divided by two.
mapVillageForgeBuyWoodenSwordSpeech: Thanks for buying! This wooden sword is quite weak, but it's a start.
mapVillageForgeBuyIronAxeSpeech: I hope you'll like this iron axe. I have just sharpened it for you!
mapVillageForgeBuyPolishedSilverSwordBut: Buy a polished silver sword (2 000 candies)
mapVillageForgeBuyPolishedSilverSwordSpe: It took me a lot of time to create this sword. I assure you that it's worth its price.
mapVillageForgeBuyLightweightBodyArmourB: Buy a lightweight body armour (15 000 candies)
mapVillageForgeBuyLightweightBodyArmourS: This body armour will offer you a protection against your enemies.
mapVillageForgeBuyScytheSpeech: It took me several months to make this scythe. It's a real piece of art. This is probably the fastest weapon you will ever be able to use. Good luck!
wishingWellThrowFirstCandyButton: Throw a candy in the well
wishingWellCandyIntroductionSpeech: Hello, wanderer! I am the wishing well. I shall grant you wishes in exchange of some sweets! When you'll throw candies into me, I will heal your wounds.
wishingWellNoWoundSpeech: You have no wounds to heal!
wishingWellThrowFirstLollipopButton: Throw a lollipop in the well
wishingWellLollipopIntroductionSpeech: Hello, wanderer! I am the wishing well. I shall grant you wishes in exchange of some sweets! When you'll throw lollipops into me, I will convert them into candies.
wishingWellLollipopDeclineSpeech: Hello, wanderer! I am the wishing well. I shall grant you wishes in exchange of some sweets! But I don't want you to be greedy now. Come back when you have more lollipops!
wishingWellThrewLollipopsSpeech: Your lollipops are converted into candies! Two lollipops for one candy.
wishingWellThrowChocolateBarButton: Throw a chocolate bar in the well
wishingWellChocolateBarIntroductionSpeec: Hello, wanderer! I am the wishing well. I shall grant you wishes in exchange of some sweets! I love chocolate bars. I really love them. For each chocolate bar you will throw into me, including this one, you will be granted the opportunity to return one item to your special someone.
wishingWellThrewChocolateBarSpeech: Which object would you like to send?
wishingWellThrowPainAuChocolatButton: Throw a pain au chocolat in the well
wishingWellPainAuChocolatIntroductionSpe: Hello, wanderer! I am the wishing well. I shall grant you wishes in exchange of some sweets! When you throw a pain au chocolat into me, you will be given a very special gift. Choose wisely.
wishingWellThrewPainAuChocolatSpeech: Thanks for the pain au chocolat! You can now choose your gift.
wishingWellGiftDoneSpeech: Done! You now have a new gift. It will appear in your inventory stats panel.
wishingWellEnchantmentDoneSpeech: There it is! Your item has been sent.
pierLighthouseButton: Go to the lighthouse by boat
lonelyHouseAskTheBoxToOpenItself: Ask the box to open itself
lonelyHouseLureTheBoxWithACandy: Lure the box with a candy
lonelyHouseTakeTheBox: Take the box with you, you probably need a key to open it anyway
lonelyHouseKickBoxResult: Your foot hurts a little bit, but nothing happens
lonelyHouseAskTheBoxToOpenItselfResult: ...you're talking to a box, you know that?
lonelyHouseLureTheBoxWithACandyResult: The box doesn't seem to care
lonelyHouseTakeTheBoxResult: There's probably something interesting in this candy box.
lighthouseQuestionWhatSpeech: I live here all day long, waiting for a boat to come. It's been a long time since I've seen a boat, but I must stay here, staring at the sea, because a boat may come.
lighthouseQuestionWhyEatCandiesSpeech: Because they're good for your health!
lighthouseQuestionCandyBoxSpeech: It is a very old box that is said to contain all the candies in the world. The legends say that whoever manages to open it would have so much candies that anything could be possible.
lighthouseQuestionDragon: The dragon told me to come here because I want candies.
lighthouseQuestionDragonSpeech: Oh, I see... Well, I cannot provide you candies directly, but I can give you something essential for you to ultimately get a LOT of candies. I just need to test you before that. Because what I have can't be given to everyone. Solve this puzzle and it will be yours.
lighthouseFoundStone: Congratulations! You passed the test. Here's {{player}} {{item}}. I hope they will like it. Good luck!
lighthouseFoundStoneAgain: Good job, you did the puzzle once again. You seem to like that.

mountainsText0: You spotted something in the mountains!
mountainsText1: It looks interesting. Maybe it could be useful.
mountainsTextButton: Climb the mountains to get the thing
mountainsTextAfter: You found {{player}} {{item}}! It was sent to them.
secondHouseIntroSpeech: Hello, I'm the candy merchant. I would do anything for candies. What do you need?
secondHouseLollipop1Speech: This is a lemon-flavored lollipop. My favourite! It costs 60 candies, but it's worth it.
secondHouseLollipop2Speech: This one is a strawberry-flavored lollipop. It tastes good. I like its red color. Only 60 candies!
secondHouseLollipop3Speech: This is a pumpkin-flavored lollipop. I bet you never tried one! 60 candies and it's yours.
secondHouseMerchantHatSpeech: I could sell you my hat, but it is very precious, you know... You will have to give me a lot of candies for it. Let's say 1 million candies. It seems fair, right?
secondHouseTimeRingSpeech: This is a time ring. It's kind of magical. It allows you to slow down the time when you're in trouble.
secondHouseLeatherGlovesSpeech: These leather gloves are made from camel leather, this is high quality. I have a lot of them in stock, that's why they are so cheap : only 300 candies!
secondHouseLeatherBootsButtonText: Buy a pair of leather boots (300 candies)
secondHouseLeatherBootsSpeech: These high quality leather boots, made from camel leather, will keep your feet warm.
secondHouseLeatherGlovesButtonText: Buy a pair of leather gloves (300 candies)
secondHouseChocolateBarSpeech: This is a chocolate bar. I don't know what it is used for, but it happens to be quite rare, which explains the price. 800 candies and it's yours!
secondHouseBuySpeech_one: This is {{player}} {{item}}. I'll send it straight to {{game}} with free express shipping for {{count}} candy!
secondHouseBuySpeech_other: This is {{player}} {{item}}. I'll send it straight to {{game}} with free express shipping for {{count}} candies!
outsideTheHoleButton: Jump in this big hole in the ground
theCaveExitText0: You finally reached the cave's exit.
theCaveExitText1: You can see a big forest outside of here.
theCaveFirstSentenceYouAre: You are in a cave. There are three paths ahead of you.
theCavePattern_ArrowsToHeartPlugSeeStran: You spot a strange thing on the ground in front of you.
theCavePattern_ChocolateBarNowSeeChocola: You spot a chocolate bar in front of you.
theCavePattern_TreasureMapSentence: You see small rocks strangely arranged on the floor.
theCavePattern_MonkeyWizardSentence: You stumble upon a naked monkey wizard.
theCavePattern_OctopusKingSentence: You stumble upon the Octopus King. It seems nasty.
fortressInsideText0: You are inside the desert fortress.
fortressInsideText1: You can choose between three doors.
fortressInsideText2: Each of them leads to a big room with a treasure at the end.
sorceressHutHello: Hello, I'm the sorceress. I can give you some interesting things that I've found from the whole multiworld. But everything has a price! And this price will be lollipops. A lot of them.
sorceressHutClickedGrimoire: This is a grimoire made for beginners. By carrying it with you in quests, you will be able to cast simple but useful spells. You need this! Only 5 000 lollipops.
sorceressHutBuyGrimoireSpeech: Thanks for buying! You will be able to cast three spells with this grimoire. Good luck!
sorceressHutClickedGrimoire2: This is an advanced grimoire. By carrying it with you in quests, you will be able to cast two advanced spells. I wrote it myself, which wasn't easy. 20 000 lollipops is a fair price.
sorceressHutBuyGrimoire2Speech: Thanks for buying! You will be able to cast two spells with this grimoire. Use them wisely!
sorceressHutClickedCauldron: This is my cauldron. It allows me to brew magic potions. I could sell it to you, but it's very precious... it will cost you 100 000 lollipops.
sorceressHutBuyCauldronSpeech: Thanks a lot! 100 000 lollipops for me! I also gave you a brewing manual. It's going to be useful.
sorceressHutClickedHat: I have a nice hat, indeed! But I really can't sell it to you. It is waaaay too precious. Really, I can't. Don't insist. No. No no no I shouldn't do that. Oh well, I'll trade it, but for 1 000 000 000 lollipops. You probably won't be able to pay that anyway.
sorceressHutBuyHatSpeech: One billion lollipops for meeeeee! But I don't have a hat anymore.. but one billion lollipops, wow! .. It was worth it.
sorceressHutClickedSpeech_one: That's {{player}} {{item}}. I'll return it to them in {{game}} for {{count}} lollipop!
sorceressHutClickedSpeech_other: That's {{player}} {{item}}. I'll return it to them in {{game}} for {{count}} lollipops!
sorceressHutClickedSpeechTwoInOne_one: That's a bundle containing {{player1}} {{item1}} and {{player2}} {{item2}}. That's two for the price of one - just {{count}} lollipop!
sorceressHutClickedSpeechTwoInOne_other: That's a bundle containing {{player1}} {{item1}} and {{player2}} {{item2}}. That's two for the price of one - just {{count}} lollipops!
sorceressHutClickedSpeechThreeInOne_one: That's a bundle containing {{player1}} {{item1}}, {{player2}} {{item2}} and {{player3}} {{item3}}. That's three for the price of one - just {{count}} lollipop!
sorceressHutClickedSpeechThreeInOne_othe: That's a bundle containing {{player1}} {{item1}}, {{player2}} {{item2}} and {{player3}} {{item3}}. That's three for the price of one - just {{count}} lollipops!
cauldronWhatYouWantToPut: What you want to put in the cauldron
cauldronWhatYouCanDo: What you can do with it
castleBigRoomHovenSpeechSad: Hello! I'm a very old bread oven. I used to cook tons of good pastries, but no one is using me anymore. Maybe... maybe you could help me? Just let me take some sweets from you! Don't worry, you won't regret it! You can trust me.
castleBigRoomHovenNotEnough: Oh... you don't have enough sweets, I can't do anything. I'm just useless. I'm the useless bread oven, that's how you should call me.
castleBigRoomHovenSpeechMadePainAuChocol: Yay! Thanks a lot! I used 100 candies and a chocolate bar, and I made... {{receiver}} {{item}}! I hope they'll enjoy it!
castleBigRoomHovenSpeechHappy: Hey! If you want me to cook another pastry, just tell me! I'd love to help you.
castleBigRoomHovenSpeechHappyNotEnough: Oh, you don't have enough sweets, sadly. I need 100 candies and a chocolate bar. Come back when you'll have that!
castleBigRoomHovenLetHovenTakeButton: Let the oven take all the sweets it wants to take
castleBigRoomHovenSpeechVerySad: Oh no, I have no more good recipes to cook! I'm sorry, perhaps you can put your chocolate bars to better use?
dragonStopTickling: Hey, you! Stop tickling me, please.
dragonStopTicklingButton: Uh, oh, sorry, I thought I was supposed to attack you
dragonTalking: I am the dragon and this is my castle. I see that you managed to enter, you must be very brave... I'd love to help someone like you. What are you looking for?
dragonTalkingChallengeSpeech: Oh, so you want challenge? I think you should make a trip to hell itself, it is known that the devil is a tough challenger. Jump on my back and I'll take you there!
dragonTalkingFameSpeech: The best way to become famous is to face the developer himself. I know where he lives and I could take you there. But be prepared, this won't be easy.
dragonTalkingCandiesSpeech: Ultimately, the thing we all want is candies, isn't it? I think a friend of mine could help you with that. You will recognise him easily, he has only one eye. Just tell him that you know me.
talkingCandySpeechNoBox: Hey! I'm the talking candy. You almost won the game. You just need to find the candy box. It's in a house outside the village. This is the last step!
talkingCandySpeech1: Hey! I'm the talking candy. Congratulations, you won the game! I will open your candy box for you, this is your reward. Should I proceed?
talkingCandySpeech2: Done! You can now enter it. I hope you liked the game :)
savePrompt: This version of Candy Box 2 saves automatically every second.
savePrompt2: If, however, you are having problems, you can erase your local save here.
savePrompt3: You will lose some of your progress, for example, the number of candies you have.
savePrompt4: However, any items discovered on the Archipelago server will be retained.

energyGuyWelcome: Hi, I'm the Energy Guy! I love lollipops and candies! I can convert your lollipops and candies to pure energy, and my magic exercise bike can produce fresh lollipops and candies made from pure energy!
energyGuyLollipopDepositComplete: Thanks for the lollipops! My stomach has converted it to pure energy! Do you want anything else?
energyGuyCandyDepositComplete: Thanks for the candies! My stomach has converted it to pure energy! Do you want anything else?
energyGuyCandyWithdrawalComplete: Here you go! Candies crafted with pure energy! Do you want anything else? (huff... huff...)
energyGuyLollipopWithdrawalComplete: Here you go! Lollipops crafted with pure energy! Do you want anything else? (huff... huff...)
